id: title:carlos-marchal-ph:treat openai invalid prompt 400 as a content filter refusal

review.posthog_relevance: Azure OpenAI integration error handling and regression testing
review.reason: Adds Azure OpenAI usage policy rejection handling to Azure-specific content filter error paths, allowing PostHog to distinguish Azure's usage policy violations from content filter violations and route the latter to ContentFilteredError. Also adds a regression test for this specific error type.
review.uncertainty: This score assumes the Azure OpenAI integration is a supported, active feature for PostHog customers; the code demonstrates the implementation and test, but does not independently verify customer adoption or production incident avoidance.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Adds Azure OpenAI's usage policy rejection to the Azure-specific content filter error handling.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog's Azure OpenAI integration to distinguish Azure's usage policy violations from Azure's content filter violations, both returning 400 before completion, and route the latter to ContentFilteredError.

observations.behavior: Makes the Azure OpenAI content filter test helper accept an optional error code and message, and adds a new test case for usage policy rejection.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a regression test for Azure OpenAI's usage policy rejection, ensuring the backend correctly identifies and reports this specific error type alongside the existing content filter error.
